name: tencent/hy4
description: Hy4 is the official release of Tencent Hunyuan's Hy4 generation, following Hy4 Preview with broad improvements, especially in agentic capabilities and long-horizon productivity tasks. It accepts text and image input, has a context window of about 1M tokens, and supports reasoning, tool calling and structured output. It targets software development, office and financial analysis, and other real-world multi-step work.
